第79章 正骨-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》

大家每天不知疲倦地拼了命地干着。在这个年代，政治任务完不成，后果是很严重的——轻则通报批评，重则处分降级，谁都担不起这个责任。大家真是拼了命地在干，天不亮就上工，天黑透了才收工，中午吃饭就蹲在工地上，吃完接着干。但没有任何人有任何怨言，这也是这个时代的特色。晚上大家都住在工地临时搭的帐篷里。

时间来到三月三十一号。

当天下午，工地上一片忙碌。一辆运输水泥预制板的卡车正在倒车，发动机轰隆隆地响，一个工人背着一筐土从后面过来，没注意到卡车在倒车，卡车尾部猛地撞上了他。

“啊——”

工人整个人被撞倒在地，土撒了一地。他捂着左臂，疼得在地上打滚。左臂以一个不自然的角度扭曲着，像折断的树枝，一看就是骨头断了。他的脸色惨白，额头冒出豆大的汗珠，嘴唇发紫，咬着牙不让自己喊出来，但喉咙里还是发出压抑的闷哼。

“出事了！出事了！”穿工作服的工人围了上来，有人喊“卫生员”，有人喊“快拿担架”，有人喊着“快送医院”。大家七手八脚地想把人抬起来，但又不敢动，怕碰坏了。

韩干部脸色铁青，从工地那头跑过来，蹲在伤员旁边，看了看那条扭曲的左臂，嘴唇哆嗦了一下，却什么也不敢动。他不是医生，不懂急救，怕一动手反而把人弄残了。

王建新正在西段那边挖土，听到动静，扔下铁锹就跑了过去。他拨开人群，蹲在伤员面前，看了一眼那条胳膊，同时神识探查迅速展开。

左肱骨中段闭合性骨折，断端错位。骨头断成了两截，上端往内侧移位，下端往外侧移位。好在没有损伤到桡神经和肱动脉——手指能动，手腕能转，脉搏还在，说明神经和血管都完好。断骨刺破了骨膜，但还没有穿破皮肤，算是闭合性骨折中比较幸运的一种。

这时刘晓东、李建国、也跑了过来，挤进人群，问怎么了。王建新没抬头，直接喊道：“刘晓东，拿夹板！李建国，拿绷带！”

“是！”两个人转身就跑。

王建新的声音一出现，现场的人突然就有了一种安心的力量。刚才还乱哄哄的，现在安静了，所有人的目光都落在王建新身上。

刘晓东很快从医疗包里翻出夹板——两片薄木板，递了过来。李建国递上绷带。

王建新双手握住伤员的左臂，灵力探查引导着他精确地感知断骨的错位方向——上端偏内，下端偏外，断端重叠了大约两厘米。他一只手握住上臂，一只手握住前臂，慢慢用力牵引，将重叠的断端拉开。

伤员疼得浑身发抖，牙齿咬得咯咯响，额头上青筋暴起。但他没喊，咬着嘴唇，嘴唇咬出了血。

王建新轻声说：“别怕，忍一下，马上就好。”

他的双手一旋、一拉、一推——

“咔嗒”一声脆响。

断骨复位了。

伤员发出一声闷哼，身体猛地绷紧了一下，然后慢慢松弛下来。他长长地呼出一口气，脸色虽然还是白的，但表情不那么痛苦了。

“好多了。”他说，“不那么疼了。”

王建新用夹板和绷带将伤员的左臂固定好，夹板夹在手臂内外两侧，绷带缠了三道，松紧适度，既能固定又不会影响血液循环。他站起来，对韩干部说：“韩干部，最好还是送医院拍个片子确认一下，但应该没什么大问题。”

韩干部看了他一眼，点了点头。他招呼人把伤员抬上担架，送上了另一辆路过的卡车，嘱咐司机直接开到医院。

Chapter 79 Bone Setting - "At the beginning of the 1970s, I made a fortune by buying goods for zero yuan"

Everyone works tirelessly and hard every day.In this era, if political tasks are not completed, the consequences will be very serious - ranging from notification of criticism to severe punishment and downgrade. No one can bear this responsibility.Everyone worked really hard. They started working before dawn and stopped working when it was completely dark. They squatted on the construction site during lunch and continued working after eating.But no one had any complaints, which is also a characteristic of this era.At night everyone lived in temporary tents on the construction site.

The time has come to March 31st.

That afternoon, the construction site was busy.A truck transporting cement prefabricated panels was reversing, its engine rumbling, and a worker carrying a basket of soil came from behind. He didn't notice that the truck was reversing, and the rear of the truck slammed into him.

"Ah——"

The worker was knocked to the ground and dirt was scattered all over the ground.He clutched his left arm and rolled on the ground in pain.The left arm was twisted at an unnatural angle, like a broken branch. It looked like the bones were broken.His face was pale, big beads of sweat appeared on his forehead, and his lips were purple. He gritted his teeth to prevent himself from shouting, but a suppressed groan still came from his throat.

"Something happened! Something happened!" Workers in work clothes gathered around. Some shouted "hygienist", some shouted "get a stretcher quickly", and some shouted "send to the hospital quickly".Everyone was trying to lift the person up, but they didn't dare to move for fear of breaking it.

Cadre Han's face was ashen, he ran over from the other side of the construction site, squatted next to the wounded, looked at the twisted left arm, his lips trembled, but he did not dare to move.He is not a doctor and does not know first aid. He is afraid that if he does it, he will maim the person.

Wang Jianxin was digging soil in the western section. When he heard the noise, he threw down his shovel and ran over.He pushed aside the crowd, squatted in front of the wounded, glanced at the arm, and at the same time quickly launched his spiritual exploration.

Closed fracture of the middle part of the left humerus with dislocation of the broken end.The bone was broken into two pieces, with the upper end displaced inward and the lower end displaced outward.Fortunately, the radial nerve and brachial artery were not damaged - the fingers can move, the wrist can turn, and the pulse is still there, indicating that the nerves and blood vessels are intact.The broken bone pierced the periosteum but did not penetrate the skin. It is considered a lucky type of closed fracture.

At this time, Liu Xiaodong and Li Jianguo also ran over, squeezed into the crowd, and asked what was wrong.Wang Jianxin didn't look up and shouted directly: "Liu Xiaodong, get the splint! Li Jianguo, get the bandage!"

"Yes!" The two people turned around and ran away.

As soon as Wang Jianxin's voice appeared, the people present suddenly felt reassured.It was noisy just now, but now it's quiet, and everyone's eyes are on Wang Jianxin.

Liu Xiaodong quickly took out the splints-two thin wooden boards from the medical bag and handed them over.Li Jianguo handed over the bandage.

Wang Jianxin held the wounded man's left arm with both hands, and his spiritual exploration guided him to accurately sense the misalignment direction of the broken bone - the upper end was biased inwards, the lower end was biased outwards, and the broken ends overlapped by about two centimeters.He held his upper arm with one hand and his forearm with the other, and slowly pulled hard to pull the overlapping broken ends apart.

The wounded man was shaking all over in pain, his teeth clenched, and veins popped out on his forehead.But he didn't shout. He bit his lip and it bled.

Wang Jianxin said softly: "Don't be afraid, just be patient and you'll be fine soon."

His hands twisted, pulled, and pushed——

There was a crisp "click" sound.

The broken bone was reset.

The wounded man let out a muffled groan, and his body suddenly tensed up, then slowly relaxed.He took a long breath, and although his face was still white, his expression was no longer painful.

"Much better," he said. "It doesn't hurt so much."

Wang Jianxin used a splint and a bandage to fix the wounded man's left arm. The splint was clamped on both sides of the arm, and the bandage was wrapped three times with moderate tightness, which can fix it without affecting blood circulation.He stood up and said to Cadre Han: "cadre Han, it's best to send him to the hospital to take a film to confirm, but there shouldn't be any big problem."

Cadre Han glanced at him and nodded.He called for people to put the injured person on a stretcher, put it on another passing truck, and told the driver to drive directly to the hospital.
